methodology: Each classified claim is assessed against current primary or official records, reputable counter-sources, implementation evidence and a claim-specific falsification standard. Scores measure evidence pressure around the claim, not truth, guilt or event probability. Policy convergence, official investigation or historical precedent cannot be converted into proof of a stronger paranormal, ritual, criminal or single-controller claim without direct evidence.
